summary: Dominion Energy filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) to incorporate risk factors related to its May 15, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger with NextEra Energy. Under the terms, WG Development Corp. (NextEra sub) will merge into Dominion, making it a wholly owned NextEra subsidiary, which then merges into CS Holdco. No per-share price or premium is disclosed in this filing. Dominion's board approved the deal; the Merger requires majority shareholder votes from both companies, HSR clearance, and approvals from FERC, NRC, Virginia SCC, North Carolina UC, and South Carolina PSC. The regulatory clock is uncertain due to multiple permits. Watch for shareholder vote dates and any burdensome regulatory conditions.
